_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::cardiac_monodomain#3, sharpened by execution. Swapping MODEL 'FHN' -> 'TNNP' in upstream scatra_myocard_FHN_material and changing nothing else runs to completion and returns phi = -85.811 where the deck expects 0.778036. The difference is not just action-potential duration: FHN's phi is a dimensionless 0..1 excitation variable and TNNP's is a transmembrane potential in mV resting near -85, so initial field, stimulus amplitude and expected values all have to be re-derived. The upstream decks confirm it -- FHN uses init 0.0 / VAL 0.3, TNNP uses init -85.423 / VAL 30 (both marker counts 11). MODEL_MISMATCH_WARNINGS=0: MODEL is just an enum and 4C accepts the mismatch silently. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the model swap: leave FHN in place. phi returns to 0.778036, the mV-scale markers flip, EXIT_SWAPPED becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
